title: The Letter Read in a Small Voice
youtube_title: The Letter Read in a Small Voice | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting your turn to talk lets someone feel heard.
summary: At a cottage hearth with the clock unhurried, Auntie June begins to tell Zola about a letter read in a small voice that still wanted an audience. Zola wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
